description: This file defines a PHP class 'Supervisor' that extends 'ListableDisplayField', used within a reporting system for a Human Resource Management (HRM) application. It specifies methods to retrieve Data Transfer Object class, relevant fields, and entity aliases related to supervisor display fields.

classes.name: Supervisor
classes.description: Represents a display field for supervisor information in HRM report generation, providing specific DTO class, fields, and aliases.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of fields relevant for the supervisor display in reports.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in query generation for this display field.
